title: 7th Meeting of the Strategic Priorities and Policy Committee

content.string: The meeting is called to order at 1:02 PM; it being noted that Mayor J. Morgan, Deputy Mayor S. Lewis, and Councillor E. Peloza were in remote attendance.

motion_texts.string: That Consent Items 2.1 to 2.3 BE APPROVED.

motion_texts.string: That the following actions be taken with respect to the 2025 Annual General Meeting of the Shareholder for London & Middlesex Community Housing:
